sources.claim: The tool's own interface or help text says its answers can be wrong (S1 scene 4: 「工具自己也提醒：回答可能有錯」). The operator pastes the vendor help-centre URL, or, if the notice exists only in the interface, names the screenshot S1_notice_01.png and the date seen. Recalled help-centre domains, unverified: help.openai.com, support.anthropic.com, support.google.com/gemini.
Recording conditions on the strip (tool, version or build, plan, date) are read from the app's own about or account screen at recording time (frame grab).
The reference page shown in Take 5 is the one named on the 資料來源 label (name, URL, date seen). The studio makes no claim about the page's content.
NO FACTUAL CLAIM about any vendor: the three-step check is the studio's own method.

media.description: Stills of the openly-AI character for the corner picture-in-picture, from the approved photoreal golden set: E04, E01, E06 and R06 right (pack pipeline/image-pack/buzhou-photoreal.md sections 4.1 and 4.4). STILL IMAGES ONLY, or a slow pan or zoom of a still (decision D6, DECISIONS.md 2026-10-12; photoreal addendum 7, risk 8 is read together with D6): no blinking, lip-sync, morphing, dissolve between two face stills or frame interpolation; expression changes are hard cuts between separate approved stills at scene boundaries; no synthetic voice. Square crops are made on copies and logged with their parent file; never flipped. Alt text for any still posted alone: AI 生成的虛擬角色步驟，示意圖，非真人。

If a file is missing or not approved, generate it with its own prompt in pipeline/image-pack/buzhou-photoreal.md (section 4.1 for E01 to E10, section 4.4 for R06); the prompt is not repeated here so the pack stays the single source of truth. Never upload a photograph of any real person. No provider adapter is called by this file; generation is manual until the operator supplies an image-API key (pipeline adapters stay inert).
